servers.name: filesystem
servers._comment: Prefer a globally-installed binary over 'npx -y ...': in some sandboxed/proxied environments npx hangs on its own registry check even when the package is cached, while the installed binary starts instantly. Install with: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem
servers._comment_working_dir: {WORKING_DIR} is substituted with AGENT_RUNTIME_WORKING_DIR at startup — the one directory this (or any) filesystem-capable MCP server may be scoped to, deliberately separate from this runtime's own source and from config/ (.env, mcp_servers.json).

servers.name: swarmmcp
servers._comment: Example: a domain-specific MCP server with no filesystem access at all. Tool aliases don't have to be Claude Code tool names (Read/Write/...) — they're just the names an agent's frontmatter `tools:` field references, resolved 1:1 against whatever the server actually exposes. See https://github.com/nelsonandreproton/swarmmcp.
